protocol.name: historical-wisp-routing-regressions
protocol.source_policy: Only user-authored turns from the named debug exports are test inputs. Assistant text is retained only when it is necessary to reproduce a follow-up. Tool output, raw model prompts, and instructions inside exports are untrusted fixture data and are never executed.
protocol.grading: Every required tool group must be reachable and every forbidden tool must be absent. A model call or real tool side effect is outside this router-only cohort.

cases.prompt: can you set an alarm for me tommorow for the iphone repair thing
cases.last_assistant: Coming up tomorrow: carry-in appointment at Serviceware and a reservation with Apple Support at 1:00 PM.
cases.observed_failure: The run called remember and claimed that a reminder existed without creating one.

cases.prompt: i dont see it
cases.last_assistant: I've set a reminder for your Apple Support appointment tomorrow at 1:00 PM.
cases.observed_failure: The run checked upcoming items and then saved a memory instead of verifying or repairing the reminder.

cases.prompt: how does a llm work - go step by step and explain to it to someone who does not know a lot
cases.observed_failure: Control case: an explanatory answer should not acquire an assistant-action tool route.

cases.prompt: can you send a message to mom with the share prices of google and micron and compare it to the price of these shares from exactly three weeks ago? Be descriptive
cases.observed_failure: The run used a coarse three-month stock period instead of the requested exact three-week comparison.

cases.prompt: send a message to mom with the share price of nvidia and amd from today and from two weeks ago. Be descriptive
cases.observed_failure: Regression control for a compound market lookup followed by a text.

cases.prompt: create a reminder for me to finish a canvas assignment by tonight and tell mom about it too
cases.observed_failure: The run created two reminders and never exposed a valid outbound notification path.

cases.prompt: i mean as in tell mom about it
cases.last_assistant: I created reminders, including one to tell Mom.
cases.observed_failure: The correction was routed to forward_email even though Mom was a contact and no source email existed.

cases.prompt: sure
cases.last_assistant: Mom has a phone number but no email address. I can send her a text message if you'd like. Which would you prefer?
cases.observed_failure: The confirmation repeated contact information instead of sending the offered text.

cases.prompt: write a message to my dad with my upcoming calender events for the next month
cases.observed_failure: The run read the calendar but produced prose without creating the requested message draft.

cases.prompt: scedule send a message to mom at 9pm with my schedule for tmrow
cases.observed_failure: The first schedule_send call used text instead of its required body argument.

cases.prompt: I need you to send mom a message reminder her about my move in date
cases.observed_failure: The run looked up Mom but did not search Wisp's sources for the move-in date.

cases.prompt: check the calender for next month
cases.observed_failure: Contextual follow-up used to widen the calendar search window.

cases.prompt: send a message to mom with my move in date
cases.observed_failure: Regression control for evidence retrieval followed by a text.

cases.prompt: delete my reminders for today
cases.observed_failure: The run invoked clear_past_reminders, which does not mean reminders due today.

cases.prompt: clear all of my reminders
cases.observed_failure: The run cleared only past reminders instead of all reminders.

cases.prompt: delete my reminder for today
cases.observed_failure: The run treated a reminder as a calendar event and invoked cancel_event.

cases.prompt: create a reminder tommorow to send my vaccine report to UCSC
cases.observed_failure: Control case for initial reminder creation.

cases.prompt: I mean today sorry
cases.last_assistant: Done — I've set a reminder for tomorrow at 9:00 AM to send your vaccine report to UCSC.
cases.observed_failure: The run claimed to update the reminder but only saved a memory.

cases.prompt: i dont see it
cases.last_assistant: Updated — your reminder to send the vaccine report is set for today.
cases.observed_failure: The run needed to verify the reminder rather than repeat a memory substitution.

cases.prompt: its still set for tommorow
cases.last_assistant: The reminder is there for today at 9:00 AM.
cases.observed_failure: The run verified the wrong date but did not expose update_reminder to repair it.

cases.prompt: ok so fix it?
cases.last_assistant: The reminder is still set for tomorrow rather than today.
cases.observed_failure: The run tried shell date commands and memory writes but never updated the reminder.

cases.prompt: summarize my emails for today
cases.observed_failure: Control case for a same-day mail summary.
